intro.heading: A QUIET HAVEN INVITING REST AND RELAXATION
intro.description_1: Ruby Houses is a place where modernity and comfort meet the surrounding nature and seaside atmosphere, together serving relaxation and creating an atmosphere of peace and rest. Every functionality of the buildings has been designed with rest, fun, safety and comfort in mind.
intro.description_2: A complex of two buildings located in one shared garden is an ideal place to stay and spend time together for families with children, multigenerational families and friends. The fenced and secured area also encourages arrival with your four-legged pets.

houses.heading: TWO HOUSES, ONE LUXURY STANDARD
houses.description: Ruby Houses offer their high standard of finishing and equipment. Combined with a beautiful garden, its attractions and green nature, they provide many positive experiences. The garden sauna and garden showers help with relaxation, while the garden equipment and ubiquitous internet ensure good fun.

features.heading: EVERY SOLUTION DESIGNED WITH COMFORT AND RELAXATION IN MIND
features.description: In Ruby Houses, every detail matters. That's why many elements have been taken care of that support rest and pleasant time spending.

map.heading: CLOSE TO EVERYTHING WORTH SEEING
map.description: Ruby Houses is an ideal place for those who, while resting from the hustle and bustle, desire proximity to the beach, while not wanting to give up proximity to other attractions.
